    Your scenes

    Protect your lungs every day

    • Don't smoke and avoid secondhand smoke.
    • Ventilate rooms; limit smoke, incense and strong chemicals.
    • Wear a mask around dust, fumes and heavy traffic.
    • See a doctor if a cough or breathlessness lasts.
